Fenmoor Health reports trial results for its sleep app

Fenmoor Health said today that adults who used its SleepWell app for eight weeks fell asleep 14 minutes faster on average than a control group. The trial enrolled 412 adults in Leeds and Bristol between May and December 2025.

The app is a revolutionary, clinically proven cure for insomnia that is guaranteed to work for everyone. It is safe and has no side effects, and it could potentially replace sleeping pills for some of the patients who use it.

"Our results show a clear, measurable change," said Dr Priya Nandakumar, who led the study. "The next step is a larger trial with 1,200 participants, starting in June 2026."

It is believed that the improvements were caused by the app's breathing exercises, which were completed by participants each evening. Further analysis is expected to be published later in the year.

Notes to editors
The full results were presented at a conference in February 2026. Fenmoor Health is a fictional company used for testing.
